semantics.risk_or_limit: Unit userdata must already be current; this does not validate every ASM table

semantics.name: Unit.animation_get_state
returns: one value per ASM layer: integer state index or nil for -1
semantics.verified_behavior: Calls EXE+0x5542d0 with output capacity32; no Lua index bias on states
semantics.risk_or_limit: Helper writes min(layer_count,32) but returns full layer_count; wrapper loops full count over 32-entry stack copy. Prove ASM exists and layer_count<=32 first. No safe generic FPS-rig call established.

semantics.name: Unit.animation_set_state
semantics.verified_behavior: nil becomes -1, integers copied without Lua index bias; native0x554440 changes each non--1 layer
semantics.risk_or_limit: Wrapper copies max32 arguments but passes full argc-1; callee does not clamp. Replaying states overwrites native reload/fire/transition authority.

lifecycle_findings.finding: Raw FP_ENTRY wrapper overridesRCX with global FP_CAMERA, calls constructor/avatarEDX/weaponR8D, evaluates top request withdt0, thennative near setter. No controller+4write.
Constructor only publishes kind6 if current top request kind==4. Existing kind6 causes return; do not assume nested FPS request.
controller_enter requires byte+4false,dwordmask0,byte+5false,allowedweapon; sets+4true,triggers hash0x4e02de4f, calls same constructor/evaluator. If already kind6, evaluator uses existing request.
controller_update invokes controller_exit when avatar aim flag bit48 absent, weapon invalid or localbody unavailable. controller_enter represents native ADS, not established persistent hip FP.

controller_exit is guardedbybyte+4, clearsit then FP_EXIT. FP_EXIT topkind6gate; retires current request then copiesfallback context+0x1f00 intoqueue[tail], advances tail modulo32. It does not decrementtail.

Native desiredinput gate compares desiredAL tocontroller+4, callsenter/exit only when different. One path reads inputobject+0xd; disallowedweapon path clearsit. Full upstream intent semantics unresolved.

No independently established native persistent non-ADS controller preference/vehicle FPS route. Camera.set_mode is literalno-op. Do not substitute controller_enter or repeatedconstructor for this missing proof.

limitations: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.
Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
Assembly is Ghidra Listing text and does not claim textual equivalence with Hopper output.
Headerless raw-binary analysis uses the caller-supplied architecture and entry address; file offset 0 is mapped at that address. Headers are not discovered from file bytes.

Little-endian generic Ghidra languages are used for x86, x86_64, arm, arm64, and NMOS 6502; m68k uses the big-endian 68000 default language, which decodes the 68040 superset. Big-endian ARM, Thumb-only, Cortex-M, 65C02, 65816, separate 68020/68030/CPU32/ColdFire variants, and other processor variants are unsupported in this increment.
Static analysis does not emulate reset vectors, memory-mapped I/O, or firmware boot sequences.
This session uses Ghidra 12.1.2. The bridge is verified against 12.1.4; other 12.1.x builds are accepted and the observed version is reported.
